dedupeText: seventies soul pop portrait layout 1970s sepia tone close up portrait drop shadow typography textured border warm palette the central portrait s warm skin tones harmonize with the burnt orange outer border the heavy drop shadows on the text create a physical separation from the image plane the framing device acts as a window with the subject s hair blending into the dark interior shadows typography is positioned in opposing corners top left and bottom right to balance the composition combine a high contrast vintage portrait with a double bordered frame and heavy shadowed condensed display type in opposing corners to evoke 70s pop soul aesthetics

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, high-contrast facial portrait framed within a double-bordered square, set against a textured terracotta background with heavy, dimensional sans-serif and script typography overlapping the frame edges.
coreVisualRelationships: The central portrait's warm skin tones harmonize with the burnt-orange outer border.
The heavy drop shadows on the text create a physical separation from the image plane.
The framing device acts as a window, with the subject's hair blending into the dark interior shadows.
Typography is positioned in opposing corners (top-left and bottom-right) to balance the composition.
coreInvariants: A grainy, film-like texture across the entire image.
A color palette restricted to shades of terracotta, deep brown, cream, and muted red.
A double-line thin black border separating the portrait from the outer margin.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up portrait centered horizontally, filling 80% of the inner frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, positioned slightly above the horizontal midline.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left text block, moves down to the eyes, follows the facial structure to the bottom-right text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The outer terracotta margin provides breathing room for the heavy typography.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep Umber/Black (Hair shadows and frame lines)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high contrast in the shadows; values are compressed into a warm, vintage range.
paletteRestrictions: No cool blues or greens except for very subtle iris details.
No pure white; use cream or off-white for highlights.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold condensed sans-serif paired with a formal copperplate-style script.
letterConstructionRules: Sans-serif glyphs feature a vertical gradient fill from cream to deep red.
Heavy, hard-edged drop shadows extending down and to the right.
Thin, high-contrast outlines around all letterforms.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The script text is scaled smaller and interlocked with the larger block letters.
The 'M' and 'K' characters have elongated vertical strokes to emphasize the condensed nature.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Superimposed script over blocky sans-serif to create a 'signature' look within the title.

preserve: The condensed width of the main text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed verticality of the primary display text.
Provides the necessary contrast as the secondary script element.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a close-up 1970s style portrait of a person with dark hair and bangs, sepia-toned skin, and blue eyes. Place this inside a square frame with a double-line border. The outer margin should be a textured terracotta orange with a grainy, vintage paper feel.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, condensed, bold sans-serif text in the top-left and bottom-right. Use a vertical red-to-cream gradient fill, a thin cream outline, and a thick dark brown drop shadow. Intertwine smaller script text within the bottom-right block.

verificationChecks: Does the text overlap the frame lines?
Is the grain consistent across the portrait and the border?
Are the shadows on the text deep and dimensional?
Is the color palette strictly warm-toned?

adjustableVariables: The specific hue of the terracotta background
The amount of overlap between text and frame
mustRedesign: Specific artist names or band logos
Exact facial features of the original subject
postGenerationChecks: Check that the eyes are the sharpest point of the image.
Ensure the drop shadows don't look like soft glows; they must be hard-edged.
Verify the gradient in the text flows from bottom (dark) to top (light).
Confirm the hair blends naturally into the dark background of the inner frame.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast vintage portrait with a double-bordered frame and heavy, shadowed, condensed display type in opposing corners to evoke 70s pop/soul aesthetics.
